name: git-for-me
description: Git for me! Tells your agent which parts of what you want to build open source already covers, on GitHub, GitLab and Codeberg: which repos to use as they are, which to adapt, and what's left to write, with every repo checked live.

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Raises GitHub's search limit from 10 a minute to 30 and adds private repos your account can see. A token with no scopes is enough. Sent only to api.github.com, never written to a report.
